role: Primed TNT: an entity with an 80-tick fuse that falls, smokes, and explodes at fuse 0 with a radius-4 (isFlaming, isSmoking) blast.

members.name: tntPlacedBy
members.note: kept as a 1/0 player flag (tnt_by_player), not an entity reference; no probe source can name another living

members.name: EntityTNTPrimed
members.note: the bare World constructor is the replay's NBT-adopt path (size 0.98/0.98, yOffset height/2, preventEntitySpawning); the fuse and placer arrive from the tape

members.name: EntityTNTPrimed
members.note: the fuse angle's Math.random draw, the 0.2D motionY and the 80-tick fuse

members.name: onUpdate
members.note: replaces the base tick outright: gravity 0.04, drag 0.98, the ground bounce, the fuse decrement and the explosion call; the smoke particle is the client's

members.name: explode
members.note: World.createExplosion(this, x, y, z, 4.0F, true) through ie_world.on_tnt_explode; servertick.c:st_tnt_prime is the fire-spread priming path that builds the same entity; in the Nether over the Nether's world and World.rand, the blast reaching livings, falling blocks and hanging entities in the entity walk's order (nether-tnt-s1, nether-unload-tnt-s1)

members.name: getShadowSize
members.note: client shadow size, not part of the server state the tick records

members.name: getTntPlacedBy
members.note: the boolean flag stands in for the reference; a TNT read back from a save has none (tntPlacedBy is not saved: the snapshot's e:-1, snapshot_entities.c, pfc-tntload-g8)

notes: surv2-tnt-s1 records a placed TNT's full fuse and blast; test_explosions.c checks the explosion pass against the oracle's dumps. The fuse's smoke particle is a client effect; the server-side cost is the absent draw, which tnt_update documents. Since lane/endreturn (2026-09-27): a TNT primed in the End explodes over the End's lists, crystals and dragon parts included, with the player who lit it as the source's entity (serverreplay.c serverreplay_end_tnt_explode; the End's item pool had no on_tnt_explode hook and tnt_replay_explode ran on the overworld), and a TNT reached by another blast keeps Entity.attackEntityFrom (no health; explosion.c attack_from_explosion), end-tnt-s42.
